rationale: David brings a decade of production robotics expertise (drones at Skycatch, tractors at Agtonomy) and is now building real-time infrastructure at LiveKit specifically for autonomous systems — exactly the foundational layer Jake is betting will give founders an unfair advantage as he builds his robot arm. Jake's conviction that low-level stack optimization and infrastructure are competitive moats in the autonomous era aligns directly with David's thesis that purpose-built real-time comms and observability are non-negotiable for production robotics.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Jake Fitzgerald — David spent a decade shipping autonomous systems to production and now leads robotics infrastructure at LiveKit; Jake is building a robot arm in public with a thesis that infrastructure and low-level compute optimization are the unfair advantage in the autonomous era.
